title: Incremental local document index
description: Hashes UTF-8 `.txt` and `.md` files, detects additions/changes/deletions, and builds a lexical inverted index with per-document term counts. Unchanged files reuse the prior token counts. Symlinked files are skipped, each file is limited to 1 MiB, and malformed prior manifests are rejected. Use `--directory ./documents --state index.json --query "voice"` to persist and query the manifest. Atomic replacement prevents partial JSON writes; concurrent writer coordination is out of scope.
